headline: Elected Councilor Carson as council chair by a 7-2 vote.
summary: Councilors Beck and Mallar nominated Councilors Faloon and Carson for the post. After brief remarks from both, seven councilors voted for Carson and two for Faloon.
decisions: Elected Councilor Carson as City Council Chair, 7-2.

decision_evidence.quote: Votes for Faloon: Beck, Faloon Votes for Carson: Cote, Dinkins, Hawes, Mallar, Pratt, Walker, Carson ... Councilor Carson was elected as Council Chair.
